title: Understanding a Source Passage
objectives: Identify the key idea in a short passage.
Support an answer with evidence from the selected source.

blocks.heading: Read for the key idea
blocks.content: Synthetic test fixture only: identify the main idea and point to the sentence that supports it.

blocks.heading: Check your understanding
blocks.content: Can you state the main idea and identify supporting evidence?

visuals.altText: A simple flow from passage to key idea to supporting evidence

spec.altText: A simple flow from passage to key idea to supporting evidence
spec.fallbackText: Read the passage, identify the key idea, then locate evidence.

workedExamples.prompt: A paragraph says a plant needs light, water and suitable soil to grow. What is its main idea?
steps: Ask what the paragraph is mostly explaining.
Use the repeated focus on plant needs.
workedExamples.answer: Plants need suitable conditions to grow.

practice.prompt: Name one condition a plant needs.

rubric.matching: Accept any one of the three listed conditions.

practice.feedback: Compare your answer with the conditions listed in the paragraph.

checkpointTest.prompt: State the main idea and give one supporting detail.
checkpointTest.feedback: A strong answer includes both main idea and evidence.

misconceptions.label: Repeating one detail rather than the main idea
misconceptions.feedback: Try saying what the whole paragraph is mostly about.

takeaways: The main idea tells what a passage is mostly about.
Supporting evidence points back to the source.

checks.name: synthetic_fixture_only
checks.details: Never display this fixture in an ordinary student production flow.
